conceptAccordion.title: Healio: The Concept That Pays for Itself
conceptAccordion.section1Text1: Statutory health insurance is the foundation. But many services people actually want to use are only partially covered or not covered at all.
conceptAccordion.section1Text2: Heilpraktiker, osteopathy, glasses, preventive care, medication and therapy co-payments: this is where people often postpone treatment or pay out of pocket.
conceptAccordion.section1Text3: Healio therefore starts with the outpatient SDK plan. The plan creates the health budget. The IKK classic bonus can then fully or partially refinance the premium.
conceptAccordion.section1Bullet1: You take out the outpatient SDK plan and get benefits you can use immediately, with no waiting period.
conceptAccordion.section1Bullet2: Optionally, you use the IKK classic bonus to recover the premium through bonus payments.
conceptAccordion.section2Title: The Core Benefit: 3,000 EUR for Your Health
conceptAccordion.section2Intro: The real benefit is not simply having another insurance plan. The benefit is building a usable health budget for treatments you would otherwise often pay for yourself.

gesundheitsbudget.title: 3,000 EUR Health Budget
gesundheitsbudget.desc: You are not investing in an abstract tariff, but in usable benefits for Heilpraktiker, glasses, preventive care and more.

behandlungen.title: Don't Postpone Treatment
behandlungen.desc: When you need support, you can use it sooner instead of waiting because of the cost.

erstattung.title: 100% Reimbursement in AP1
erstattung.desc: In the recommended SDK Ambulant 100 plan, you submit invoices and receive reimbursement for insured benefits up to the budgets.

bonus.title: IKK Bonus as a Boost
bonus.desc: The bonus is not the plan itself, but the lever that can fully or partially offset your premium depending on the bonus amount.

conceptAccordion.hinweis: Healio is not a health insurance fund. Healio helps you combine the outpatient SDK plan and the IKK classic bonus in a meaningful way.

testimonials.title: How the <highlight>health budget</highlight> adds up
testimonials.subtitle: Six example scenarios of how plan benefits and IKK bonuses can be combined. Model calculations based on the plan conditions, not customer reviews.

julia.name: Example: osteopathy series
julia.text: Paying 80 euros per session yourself adds up quickly. In the Ambulant 100 plan, naturopathic treatments by non-medical practitioners and doctors are reimbursed with up to 1,000 euros over two years. IKK bonuses for check-ups and sports come on top.

thomas.name: Example: family
thomas.text: Glasses for the child, osteopathy after pregnancy, dental cleaning via the IKK health account and the sports club bonus: every insured family member has their own budgets, and IKK bonuses apply per person.

max.name: Example: student life
max.text: Glasses are subsidised with up to 500 euros every two years in the Ambulant 100 plan. On top come IKK bonuses, for example 75 euros for university sports or a sports club and 15 euros per vaccination. The plan costs 31.64 euros per month at age 30.

sandra.name: Example: treatment series
sandra.text: Many patients break off treatment series because the money runs out. With the budget for naturopathic treatments, longer series can be planned without therapy failing for financial reasons. That is exactly what the health budget is for.

andreas.name: Example: varifocal glasses
andreas.text: For varifocal glasses costing 680 euros, the Ambulant 100 plan covers up to 500 euros. Professional dental cleaning can additionally be subsidised via the IKK health account.

lisa.name: Example: young family
lisa.text: Newborns can be added within two months without a health assessment. Midwife on-call service, minerals during pregnancy and postnatal courses are subsidised via IKK bonuses.

ikkWechsel.fearsTitle: Common Concerns, And Why They're Unfounded

leistungen.q: Will I lose benefits by switching?
leistungen.a: No. Over 98% of all statutory health insurance benefits are legally mandated and identical at every health insurance fund, doctor visits, hospital stays, medications, therapies. Only the so-called supplementary statutory benefits (approx. 2%) have minor differences, e.g. subsidies for osteopathy or travel vaccinations. Here, IKK classic actually offers more than many other funds.

arzt.q: Do I have to change my doctor or therapist?
arzt.a: No, absolutely not. You keep all your doctors, therapists and hospitals. Free choice of doctor is guaranteed by law and applies equally at every statutory health insurance fund.

kompliziert.a: Not at all. You sign up online with IKK classic, it takes just a few minutes. IKK classic automatically cancels your old fund for you. If you already have an ongoing treatment, briefly inform IKK classic after the switch.

luecke.q: Will there be a gap in my coverage?
luecke.a: No. The transition is seamless. From the first day at IKK classic, you're fully insured, no waiting periods, no interruption.

behandlungen.a: Ongoing treatments are generally not interrupted. The important point is that, for privacy reasons, this information is not automatically transferred from your old fund to IKK classic. After switching, briefly inform IKK classic which doctor, therapist or provider is treating you.
